subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire #41372 now, or keep it open as the broad field-report umbrella until every remaining slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked?
rationale: Current source and related issues prove partial fixes and active canonical work, but the report spans several product-policy areas where one automation decision would be too broad.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link unresolved behavior to focused canonical issues such as #85695, #100072, and #55792, preserve this report as evidence, then close once the tracker set is complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production field report while maintainers continue auditing weaker or untracked slices here.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close with links to the strongest active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link unresolved behavior to focused canonical issues such as #85695, #100072, and #55792, preserve this report as evidence, then close once the tracker set is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface product-routing and issue-hygiene choice, and steipete has the broadest observed history across the affected docs, config, cron, and Discord surfaces.
